message.content:
The most common English pronunciation of **doge** is **“doj”** — rhyming with *dodge* but with a softer **j/zh** sound, often written as **/doʊʒ/** or **/doʊdʒ/**.[1][2][4]

For the **Venetian title** sense, some sources note an Italian/Venetian form closer to **“DOH-zeh”** or **/ˈdo.ze/**, but in modern English usage, especially for the meme/crypto term, **“doj”** is the standard pronunciation.[1][6]
